prompt: Many animals are ______ today because their homes are destroyed.
explanation: 表示“濒危的”用 endangered。

prompt: Their ______ are being destroyed by people.
explanation: 指多个栖息地，用复数 habitats。

prompt: Keeping a pet is a big ______.
explanation: a big 后接名词 responsibility。

prompt: If we keep asking questions, we ______ more about the world.
explanation: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：National parks ______ (build) to keep animals safe.
explanation: 主语是复数、表示一般事实，用一般现在时被动语态 are built。

prompt: 翻译：我们应该保护濒危动物。
explanation: 参考译文：We should protect endangered animals.

prompt: Confucius was a great thinker in ______ China.
explanation: 古代中国用 ancient China。

prompt: Marie Curie ______ two new elements.
explanation: 科学上“发现”元素用 discovered。

prompt: Three ______ live together in my family.
explanation: 三代人用复数 generations。

prompt: Her ______ helped me a lot. She told me to make a plan.
explanation: advice 是不可数名词。

prompt: I don't know where ______.
explanation: 宾语从句用陈述语序。

prompt: Our class started a ______ to help stray animals.
explanation: 公益活动用 campaign。

prompt: A ______ diet keeps us healthy.
explanation: 修饰 diet 用形容词 balanced。

prompt: The novel ______ by Mark Twain is very famous.
explanation: 过去分词 written 作后置定语。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：Good food gives us ______ (energetic).
explanation: give sb. sth. 后接名词 energy。

prompt: 翻译：如果你有问题，就和朋友谈谈。
answer: If you have a problem, talk to your friends.
explanation: 参考译文：If you have a problem, talk to your friends.
accept: If you have a problem, talk with your friends

prompt: Zheng He ______ to many countries seven times.
explanation: 叙述历史用一般过去时 sailed。

prompt: It took me months to ______ to the new life.
explanation: adapt to 意为“适应”。

prompt: People there have different ______.
explanation: 表示“风俗”用复数 customs。

prompt: Environmental ______ is a serious problem.
explanation: 主语需要名词 pollution。

prompt: If everyone ______, the earth will become cleaner.
explanation: 条件从句主语 everyone 作第三人称单数，用 helps。

prompt: During an ______, stay calm and hide under a desk.
explanation: 地震时躲到桌下，earthquake。

prompt: Rescue teams ______ to help people last week.
explanation: last week 且救援队是“被派出”，用 were sent。

prompt: Every ______ trains hard to become a champion.
explanation: 运动员用 athlete。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：Too much ______ (stressful) can harm your body.
explanation: much 后接不可数名词 stress。

prompt: 翻译：听音乐能帮助我放松。
answer: Listening to music helps me relax.
explanation: 参考译文：Listening to music helps me relax.
accept: Listening to music can help me relax

prompt: The town ______ I grew up has changed a lot.
explanation: 先行词表地点、从句不缺成分，用关系副词 where。

prompt: The old market, ______ was built in 1920, is now a library.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句不能用 that，指物用 which。

prompt: Global communication is now ______ important.
explanation: 修饰形容词用副词 increasingly。

prompt: Anyone ______ wants to know the town's history should visit the museum.
explanation: 先行词 anyone 指人，用 who。

prompt: ______ in 1920, the market is now a library.
explanation: market 与 build 是被动关系，用过去分词作状语。

prompt: I met a teacher ______ advice changed my life.
explanation: advice 与 teacher 是所属关系，用 whose。

prompt: It was three years ago ______ I made this choice.
explanation: 强调句型 It was ... that ...。

prompt: The number of students ______ increasing these years.
explanation: the number of 作主语视为单数，用 is。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：Learning about other cultures ______ (help) us become open-minded.
explanation: 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 helps。

prompt: 翻译：这是我长大的那个小镇。
answer: This is the town where I grew up.
explanation: 参考译文：This is the town where I grew up.

prompt: ______ by his teacher, he worked harder than before.
explanation: he 与 encourage 是被动关系，用过去分词。

prompt: She managed ______ the scholarship last year.
explanation: manage 后接不定式 to do。

prompt: The new device ______ in hospitals now.
explanation: device 是被使用，用一般现在时被动语态。

prompt: ______ the news, she couldn't help crying.
explanation: she 与 hear 是主动关系，用现在分词作状语。

prompt: He is determined ______ his goal this year.
explanation: be determined to do 是固定搭配。

prompt: The progress ______ so far is encouraging.
explanation: progress 与 make 是被动关系，用过去分词作定语。

prompt: Not ______ what to say, he kept silent.
explanation: he 与 know 是主动关系，用现在分词。

prompt: It is important for students ______ how to learn.
explanation: It is + adj. + for sb. + to do 结构。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：The prize ______ (award) to her last week.
explanation: last week 且奖是“被颁发”，用一般过去时被动语态。

prompt: 翻译：他下定决心要实现自己的目标。
answer: He is determined to achieve his goal.
explanation: 参考译文：He is determined to achieve his goal.

prompt: ______ surprises me most is the simple design.
explanation: 从句缺主语，用连接代词 What。

prompt: The question is ______ we can finish the work on time.
explanation: 表语从句表示“是否”，用 whether。

prompt: ______ we ever notice these designs is a good question.
explanation: 主语从句位于句首时用 Whether，不用 If。

prompt: Good reporters separate facts ______ opinions.
explanation: separate A from B 是固定搭配。

prompt: You ______ be polite to others, even when you disagree.
explanation: 表示“应该”用 should。

prompt: He ______ have told me earlier; I would have helped.
explanation: should have done 表示“本该做而没做”。

prompt: Readers need ______, not persuaded.
explanation: need 后接名词 information。

prompt: The trip was so ______ that I still dream about it.
explanation: 修饰事物 the trip 用 -ing/-ive 类形容词 impressive。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：It is not always easy ______ (judge) whether a story is true.
explanation: It is + adj. + to do 结构。

prompt: 翻译：媒体在我们的日常生活中扮演重要角色。
answer: The media plays an important role in our daily life.
explanation: 参考译文：The media plays an important role in our daily life.

prompt: Before the exam I felt ______ and could not sleep.
explanation: feel 后接形容词 anxious。

prompt: Talking to her made me feel ______.
explanation: feel 后接形容词 relieved。

prompt: Everyone can make a ______ to the community.
explanation: make a difference 是固定搭配。

prompt: The programme ______ for three months so far.
explanation: so far 提示现在完成时。

prompt: The river ______ for over twenty years before the factory closed.
explanation: 过去的过去，用过去完成时被动语态。

prompt: More trees ______ next spring.
explanation: 树是被种植，用一般将来时被动语态。

prompt: The soup ______ delicious.
explanation: taste 是系动词，不用被动，主语单数用 tastes。

prompt: Volunteering not only helps others but also ______ us skills.
explanation: not only ... but also ... 连接并列谓语，主语动名词视为单数。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：Being ______ (honesty) about how we feel is the first step.
explanation: be 后接形容词 honest。

prompt: 翻译：和朋友谈谈能帮助我缓解压力。
answer: Talking to friends can help me relieve stress.
explanation: 参考译文：Talking to friends can help me relieve stress.
accept: Talking with friends can help me reduce stress

prompt: It was my grandfather ______ taught me how to decide.
explanation: 强调人用 who（或 that）。

prompt: It was not the piano ______ I disliked.
explanation: 强调句连接词用 that；此处被强调部分是 the piano。

prompt: Every choice has a ______, so think before you act.
explanation: a 后接名词 consequence。

prompt: Digital humans ______ by scientists look almost real.
explanation: digital humans 与 create 是被动关系，用过去分词作定语。

prompt: The technology, ______ is used in hospitals, saves time.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物用 which。

prompt: Creativity ______ when we ask questions.
explanation: 主语 creativity 不可数视为单数，用 grows。

prompt: ______ inspired by that accident, we built a chair.
explanation: we 与 inspire 是被动关系，用过去分词。

prompt: Only by watching closely ______ find inspiration.
explanation: Only + 状语置于句首，主句部分倒装。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：The most ______ (origin) work won the prize.
explanation: the most 后接形容词 original。

prompt: 翻译：是我的祖父教会了我怎样做决定。
answer: It was my grandfather who taught me how to make a decision.
explanation: 参考译文：It was my grandfather who taught me how to make a decision.
accept: It was my grandfather that taught me how to make a decision

prompt: Tolerance is a sign of ______.
explanation: of 后接名词 confidence。

prompt: Hardly ______ she finished reading when tears came to her eyes.
explanation: Hardly ... when ... 用过去完成时并部分倒装。

prompt: Never ______ I seen her so happy.
explanation: Never 置于句首，主语 I 用 have 构成倒装。

prompt: Living abroad gives us new ______ on our culture.
explanation: 多个视角用复数 perspectives。

prompt: It is these small things ______ really matter.
explanation: 强调句型用 that。

prompt: The mind and the body ______ connected.
explanation: 主语是并列的两部分，谓语用复数 are。

prompt: Exercise can ______ anxiety.
explanation: 情态动词后接动词原形 relieve。

prompt: A word used in the wrong ______ can hurt.
explanation: 语境用 context。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：______ (compare) with my hometown, London is noisier.
explanation: Compared with ... 是固定分词短语，表示“与……相比”。

prompt: 翻译：我们走得越远，就越能包容。
answer: The more we travel, the more we accept.
explanation: 参考译文：The more we travel, the more we accept.

prompt: A good headline catches the eye, but an ______ report gives the facts.
explanation: 修饰名词 report 用形容词 objective。

prompt: ______ the message is clear or hidden, readers need to think.
explanation: whether ... or ... 引导让步状语从句，句首不用 If。

prompt: The words a reporter chooses can ______ readers.
explanation: 情态动词后接动词原形 persuade。

prompt: Nutrition and exercise ______ more than medicine for many older adults.
explanation: 主语是并列两部分，谓语用原形 matter。

prompt: My grandmother, ______ is eighty-six, walks every morning.
explanation: 非限制性定语从句指人用 who。

prompt: Long-distance transport ______ a lot of carbon.
explanation: 主语 transport 不可数视为单数。

prompt: I am not sure ______ eating meat is wrong.
explanation: 表示“是否”用 whether，此处也可用 if，但正式文体首选 whether。

prompt: Driven by data, machines only know ______ we teach them.
explanation: teach 缺宾语，用连接代词 what。

prompt: 用所给词的正确形式填空：The future ______ (shape) by the choices we make today.
explanation: 未来是“被塑造”的，用一般将来时被动语态。

prompt: 翻译：技术改变了我们的生活方式，但也带来了新的风险。
answer: Technology has changed the way we live, but it has also created new risks.
explanation: 参考译文：Technology has changed the way we live, but it has also created new risks.
